classification.difficultyReason: The critical digits are already circled, so students copy each digit and compare it with 5 to state up or down; no rounded value is required.

inlines.text: State the critical digit in each of the following numbers and decide whether to round up or down.
rounded to the nearest whole number.

answer.worked: The digit immediately after the tenths place is $1$. Since $1<5$, round down.
The digit immediately after the hundredths place is $7$. Since $7\geq5$, round up.
The digit immediately after the thousandths place is $4$. Since $4<5$, round down.
The digit immediately after the units place is $8$. Since $8\geq5$, round up.
